summary: Public API is stateless image input to structured dict; singleton model caching; full pipeline exposed through get_eye().analyze_structured.
Large heterogeneous CPU pipeline combining detector, image-text encoder, dense features, OCR, captioning, region and hand-authored semantic projection.
Initial adversarial hard-set strict coverage 35.3%; documents class-vocabulary, art/AI OOD, OCR, compositional and cascade failures.
Later hard-set strict coverage 87.8% after targeted vocabulary/projection gap-close; lenient CLIP 94.6% at threshold 0.20. Must not be interpreted as clean final held-out truth accuracy.
Recurrent networks exhibit explaining-away computation for occluded object recognition under controlled comparisons.
Object and scene processing interact bidirectionally and can be modeled as joint probabilistic inference.
Hybrid frame/event automotive detector demonstrates a concrete low-latency/low-bandwidth advantage in its task.
StreamArena exposes long-horizon failures of recent-frame/text-compression visual memory and reports benefit from persistent streaming state.
Toy models expose prior dominance, ghost-object persistence and selective-compute tradeoffs; not live Retina evidence.
